conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help managing my accounts. I have two checking accounts with you — a Green Account and a Silver Account — and honestly, having two checking accounts is getting confusing. First, I want to close my Green Account and just keep the Silver one going forward. The Green Account is empty — I already moved the money out. And second, I’ve also been meaning to open a savings account.

{
  "message": "I can help with both closing your Green checking account and opening a savings account — thanks for the details so far. Before I can access or change your accounts I need to verify your identity. Would you like to verify with the email on your account, your user ID, or your full name? Once you tell me which to use I’ll look up your profile and then ask you to confirm any 2 of these: date of birth, phone number, or address (we only need two).

A few quick things I’ll do once you’re verified:
- Confirm the Green Account’s status (ensure it’s truly zero balance and has no pending transactions) and check whether any early-closure fee or notice period applies.
- Close the Green Account for you using the proper close procedure if everything’s OK.
- Confirm eligibility to open a personal savings account (you must have at least one active checking account and meet the 14-day checking-tenure requirement).
- If eligible, I’ll open the savings account using the exact account name you want (the account_class must end with “Account” — e.g., “Silver Plus Account” or “Gold Account”). I can also transfer an opening deposit from your Silver checking now if you’d like; tell me the amount to transfer or say you’ll fund it later.

Please tell me which identifier you’d like me to look up (email, user ID, or full name), and which savings account class you want to open (or say you need help picking one), and whether you want an immediate transfer from your Silver checking (and if so, the amount)."
}
